label: rem:direct-limit-lusztig
title: Direct limit algebra and the Lusztig integral form
html:
We explicitly realise the algebra \mathcal{A}_\infty (direct limit algebra) as the Lusztig integral form of the quantised enveloping algebra \mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) [lusztig1993]. At each level n, we obtain the fibre algebra \mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2) by specialising the \mathbb{Z}[q,q^{-1}]-form \mathcal{U}^{\mathbb{Z}}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) (substrate parameter) along q \mapsto q_n \in k^{\times}. The direct limit inherits the divided power basis (E^{(m)}, F^{(m)}, K^{\pm 1}) from the integral form. This ensures that the quaternionic jet embedding (quaternionic spectral resolvents) remains robust under the arithmetic descent to M_0. The q-deformed scaling function \exp_q(r) - 1 (equation eq:q-exp) regulates the transition between the divided power bases of the space-like and time-like resolvents.

The Gröbner--Shirshov normal-form theorem [leitnerpawloski2004], applied to \mathrm{Dist}(G) [fred2005], guarantees the flatness of this specialisation: the divided-power basis is free over \mathbb{Z}[q,q^{-1}] and hence remains a basis after q \mapsto q_n. In the p-adic setting, the (Witt vector lift) converts this algebraic flatness into a geometric statement. The formal group \widehat{G} over \mathbb{Z}_p reduces modulo p to the commutative formal group H over \mathbb{F}_p. The divided-power basis of \mathrm{Dist}(\widehat{G}) restricts to the PBW basis of \mathrm{Dist}(H).
